content: Abun, isàkal naa bɛ làkyàwiyà anà Klistɔ, làleŋ indiir a du, ikal awà Klistɔ, awà wàŋàbwaay u kɔɔ a ibaal a Nzam.
Làpɛ an'kyän abɛ unsà indiir a du, wɛɛ kà unsà byàmɛɛn anki.
Ntɔn, bɛ làkyàkwà, mɔ̈ɔ̈ abɛ wàŋàyee uboo a Klistɔ, amu Nzam.
Mpal usàmɛnà Klistɔ awà mɔ̈ɔ̈ abɛ, apan, bɛ sye làsàmɛnà anà nde, unsà làkoo ande.
Mɔ̈ɔ̈ itaan anà wàkün
Làdwä indiir a mɛɛn byanswà u mɔ̈ɔ̈ abɛ: ipasàsɛ, ŋingyäy, ilään, làmfɛɛl, anà unkaam abà itɛk.
Indiir a tub abi ifàgyool nkyɛl a Nzam udu a baan un'tswe ngwal.
Le nkääl làkäl bɛ anà ya, mpal làkäl bɛ uboo a mɔ̈ɔ̈ awun.
Wɛɛ mpalàbà, bɛ sye, làkɔɔb indiir abi byanswà: nkyɛl, itsumbuun, ful, ntwee anà ndaa a kɔɔrà abyà byàfàtoo u mun abɛ.
Twon lan'kur bɛ a bɛ, ntɔn bɛ làkyàkɔɔb imbuur abɛ kyà itaan anà nsyääl akya,
anà bɛ làkyàbwaar mbuur akün awà afàbwool taaŋ lanswà uboo a ngyööb asaŋaa isii a Nkyer ande.

Abun, mbuur mpa awà Un'yudà itàkal naa Un'yudà ufàkal anki, itàkal bàŋàkyɛy anà bàkɔ̈ɔ̈n aŋàkyɛy, itàkal mbuur a mbuur anà kimbuur, itàkal un'sɔ anà mbuur a nsaay, wɛɛ Klistɔ: nde wà ya yanswà amu baar banswà.
Ntɔn bɛ làbà aŋàsɔɔl, bà in'kyɛɛl, bànkwen akà Nzam, abun làkäl anà mpem aŋàbwaŋ, mpem a ngyɛb, ukwen, làbɔ̈ɔ̈n, anà nkääŋ a mpem.
Làkäl anà nkääŋ a mpem bɛ a bɛ, kya isàkal naa umwɛy uboo a bɛ we anà ikɔk a ndaa anà wumwɛy, làdwääl nkul bɛ a bɛ, asànaa kàladwääl Klistɔ, làkyer abun sye bɛ a bɛ.
Unsà ya yanswà, làkäl anà ukwen, wa wà asànaa un'siŋ a ngwal ufàlatüüb.
Wɛy duu a Klistɔ làyaal mpem abɛ, duu alà bàlabel bɛ banswà ntɔn mutɔŋ ndür mwɛy. Làyöb mufuur an'tɔɔn.

Wɛy ndaa a Klistɔ anà un'naaŋ aya wanswà ikäl amu bɛ! Làlɔŋàkà anà làweey amwɛy anà bumwɛy unsà an'yeerà manswà. Làtɔ̈ɔ̈l Nzam an'diim u mpem abɛ wanswà anà mfuur an'tɔɔn, u mbwo a an'diim, ikwɛŋ, anà an'diim ufàpà Dweelà.
Undiir wanswà lan'kwo bɛ mutɛn itàkal mukyer, làkyer wa kà ikɔb a Mwol Yɛsu, unsà mfuur an'tɔɔn akà Taa Nzam u mbwo a nde.
Nkääl akün uboo a bɔr
Akaar, lawem adim abɛ, asànaa abà ukwen a Mwol.
Abaal, lakwen akyay abɛ, twon lan'kal anà itsumbuun akà ba.
Baan, làkäl anà unkyeey akà aböör abɛ unsà indiir byanswà, ntɔn ya ifàpà un'sak akà Mwol.
Bàtaa, twon lan'pà baan abɛ unkiiŋ, manà ba bàkɔ̈ɔ̈n ayàkal anà un'kanà.

Asɔ, làkäl anà unkyeey akà ankum abɛ unsà indiir byanswà u mɛɛn pà. Làkyer abun, kà nà u mpal bàlaseyà ba anki, asànaa bɛ làleŋà mupà un'sak akà baar, wɛɛ kà unsà mpem yweel anki, ntɔn bɛ làfàtiin Mwol bɔɔmà.
Itàkal naa isal abɛ akyɛy kyà kà aben, làkyer kya u mpem aŋàbwaŋ, ntɔn Mwol, wɛɛ kà ntɔn baar anki.
Làyöb naa bɛ làsàwal làfur akà Mwol, la là kwal kàlɔ̈ɔ̈n nde ntɔn aŋikyɛɛl. Ntɔn Nkum a ndandaa làsyääl bɛ wà Klistɔ.
Mbuur mpa awà balàbal asàwal làfur a nkɔ̈ɔ̈n a balàbal ande, un'kɔl aŋàyɔŋ watɛy.
